title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: params/roles/stop/logprobs/formatting + streaming stability
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for /v1/chat.completions to feature parity across parameters (max_tokens/temperature/top_p/presence_penalty/frequency_penalty), role semantics, stop sequences/logprobs passthrough, structured response formatting, and streaming stability for tool/function-calling use-cases. This PR unifies parameter handling, aligns role mapping with OpenAI's chat roles, preserves stop tokens and logprobs in streaming and non-streaming paths, and stabilizes the streaming backpressure/flush logic used during function/tool calls. Changes include runtime fixes, API layer mapping, extended unit and integration tests, and docs/examples updates. Checklist: 1) Parameter parity mapping implemented and tested; 2) Role handling normalized across client SDKs and compatibility layer; 3) Stop token and logprobs passthrough preserved for both sync and streaming endpoints; 4) Streaming backpressure fixes + improved chunk framing for function/tool call scenarios; 5) Structured output formatter added to ensure deterministic JSON blocks in responses; 6) Integration tests for OpenAI-compat smoke and tool-calling scenarios added; 7) Docs and quickstart examples updated. Impact: no breaking changes to Redwood native API; this improves compatibility for customers migrating from OpenAI APIs and for SDKs that rely on exact behavior for model parity.
commits: feat(openai-compat): implement full params mapping for chat.completions (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, penalties)
fix(streaming): address backpressure hang when function payloads exceed chunk boundary; flush on EOF and improved buffer accounting
feat(formatter): deterministic structured-output formatter for tool/function call JSON blocks
test(openai-compat): add integration tests for roles/stop/logprobs parity and streaming tool calls
docs: update openai_compat.md and examples to document parity details and caveats
chore(ci): add e2e compatibility job and increase timeout for streaming-based tests

Priya Desai: CI flaked once on e2e timeout, reran and all tests passed; approving after CI green.

perf/canary: measured small improvement in streaming throughput for tool calls (~4%)
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: added full params mapping (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, presence/frequency penalties), normalized role handling to match OpenAI semantics, preserved stop sequence and logprobs passthrough for both streaming and non-streaming endpoints, deterministic structured output formatter for tool/function JSON payloads, and streaming backpressure fixes for function/tool call scenarios. No breaking changes to Redwood native API.
notes_for_release_team: Docs updated (docs/openai_compat.md) with compatibility caveats and the new 'compat.legacy_structured_output' feature flag. Recommend adding a short note to ChangeLog and notifying customers on the SDKs slack channel about improved parity and the new feature flag.
impact_summary: Consumers using the OpenAI compatibility layer can expect closer parity in behavior for chat.completions parameters, roles, stops and logprobs. Streaming tool/function calls should be more stable and produce deterministic JSON blocks for structured outputs. Performance impact measured and acceptable (<1% p95 latency regression; throughput improved in some workloads).
